_comment: Committed floor for the chat eval gate (app.eval.chat_gate). Regenerate with `python -m app.eval.chat_gate --update-baseline` after an INTENTIONAL corpus/annotation change — never to paper over a regression. `covered_hard_failures` is the subset of ChatHardFailure that the corpus annotation (Canonique.hard_failures, #2443.5) derives from at least one canonical scenario — NOT every hard failure the repo tests (VENDOR_NAMED, for instance, is guarded elsewhere: test_copilote_prompt_blocks.py) — see chat_gate.py's docstring.
